clips.title: The story
paras: Quel'Lithien Lodge is an isolated high elven hunting lodge nestled in the forested northern hills of the Eastern Plaguelands near the entrance to Quel'Thalas. Its Farstrider rangers hold out among the blighted woods, surrounded by the Scourge and hunted by Forsaken agents, while guarding old elven archives.

Before the Third War, Quel'Lithien was a Farstrider camp on the road toward Quel'Thalas, and it housed elven records of the ranger order. The lodge fell on hard times after the Scourge swept through Lordaeron and into the elven kingdom. Today its rangers keep their vigil in the corrupted forest, one of only two major concentrations of high elves left in Lordaeron.
